# A fixture strength ladder

## Statement
Two levels, so that the fixture register holds a ladder of its own and the job
has to scan the ladder directory to find it.

## Levels

| Level | Wording | Evidence that reaches it |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Reported: "X says / reports …" | One source, attributed |
| 2 | Documented in a case: "in this case, …" | A primary document or a documented single case |

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-12 · `E-15.text` — the strength a claim may be phrased at.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture ladder for the Knowledge Maintenance job: an invariant past its
`review_by`, which §5 reviews rather than expires.
